reason: A DSH Web GUI plugin that adds a floating panel for browsing, loading, and jumping to questions in the current conversation history.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加悬浮会话导航面板，用于浏览当前会话的历史提问并快速跳转。
summaries.en: Adds a floating navigation panel to the DSH Web GUI for browsing and quickly jumping to questions in the current session history.

capabilities: Displays a hoverable session-history navigation panel
Reads and incrementally indexes historical conversation questions
Persists a session-question index to a local file
Navigates to earlier questions and loads older history pages
